verses.text: And in that day thou shalt say, I will give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah; for though thou wast angry with me, thine anger is turned away and thou comfortest me.

segments.text: And in that day thou shalt say, I will give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah; for though thou wast angry with me, thine anger is turned away and thou comfortest me.

verses.text: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and will not be afraid: for Jehovah, even Jehovah, is my strength and song; and he is become my salvation.

segments.text: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and will not be afraid: for Jehovah,
Jehovah, is my strength and song; and he is become my salvation.

verses.text: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.

segments.text: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.

verses.text: And in that day shall ye say, Give thanks unto Jehovah, call upon his name, declare his doings among the peoples, make mention that his name is exalted.

segments.text: And in that day shall ye say, Give thanks unto Jehovah, call upon his name, declare his doings among the peoples, make mention that his name is exalted.

verses.text: Sing unto Jehovah; for he hath done excellent things: let this be known in all the earth.

segments.text: Sing unto Jehovah; for he hath done excellent things: let this be known in all the earth.

verses.text: Cry aloud and shout, thou inhabitant of Zion; for great in the midst of thee is the Holy One of Israel.

segments.text: Cry aloud and shout, thou inhabitant of Zion; for great in the midst of thee is the Holy One of Israel.
